description: Sediment transport (S 10 1, bed load, S 31 1) with NHFLOW on a curvilinear grid (G 50 2): bed-load dam break over a flat erodible bed, the grid the Cartesian one turned by 90 deg and shifted; per cell index the Cartesian run to round-off (sediment_curvilinear/t1).
covers: sediment_curv: face normals P, Q, contravariant cell velocity, face sign, chain-rule bed gradient
sediment_exner_curv (topovel_curv), the symmetric filter of the curvilinear grid (sediment_xfilter)
bedslope, bedload direction, bed shear on the curvilinear grid; the curvilinear time step of NHFLOW
